arxiv-2202-11008.title: The kinks, the solitons, the breathers and the shocks in series connected discrete Josephson transmission lines
arxiv-2202-11008.creator: Eugene Kogan
arxiv-2202-11008.description: Abstract We analytically study the localized running waves in the discrete Josephson transmission lines (JTL), constructed from Josephson junctions (JJ) and capacitors. The quasi-continuum approximation reduces calculation of the running wave properties to the problem of equilibrium of an elastic rod in the potential field.

arxiv-2212-13030.title: Diquarkyonic matter: quarks, diquarks and baryons
arxiv-2212-13030.creator: Aaron Park, Su Houng Lee
arxiv-2212-13030.description: Abstract In this work, we investigate the color-spin interaction of a quark, a diquark and a baryon with their surrounding baryons and/or quark matter. We extend our previous work Park:2022qew by increasing the maximum number of surrounding baryons to 5 and additionally consider all possible diquark probes that are immersed in such surroundings.

arxiv-2304-01051.title: Optimal control of quasi-1D Bose gases in optical box potentials
arxiv-2304-01051.creator: A. Deutschmann-Olek, K. Schrom, N. Würkner, J. Schmiedmayer, S. Erne, A. Kugi
arxiv-2304-01051.description: Abstract In this paper, we investigate the manipulation of quasi-1D Bose gases that are trapped in a highly elongated potential by optimal control methods. The effective mean-field dynamics of the gas can be described by a one-dimensional non-polynomial Schrödinger equation.

arxiv-2305-00523.title: Starobinsky-Type B − L B-L Higgs Inflation Leading Beyond MSSM
arxiv-2305-00523.description: Abstract Models of induced-gravity inflation are formulated within Supergravity employing as inflaton the Higgs field which leads to a spontaneous breaking of a U ​ ( 1 ) B − L U(1)_{B-L} symmetry at M GUT = 2 ⋅ 10 16 ​ GeV M_{\rm GUT}=2\cdot 10^{16}~{\mbox{\rm GeV}} .

arxiv-2305-07405.title: The Wiener index and the Wiener Complexity of the zero-divisor graph of a ring
arxiv-2305-07405.creator: David Dolžan
arxiv-2305-07405.description: Abstract We calculate the Wiener index of the zero-divisor graph of a finite semisimple ring. We also calculate the Wiener complexity of the zero-divisor graph of a finite simple ring and find an upper bound for the Wiener complexity in the semisimple case.

arxiv-2306-03815.title: Visible quasihyperbolic geodesics
arxiv-2306-03815.creator: Vasudevarao Allu, Abhishek Pandey
arxiv-2306-03815.description: Abstract . In this paper, motivated by the work of Bonk, Heinonen, and Koskela (Asterisque, 2001), we consider the problem of the equivalence of the Gromov boundary and Euclidean boundary. Our strategy to study this problem comes from the recent work of Bharali and Zimmer (Adv. Math., 2017) and Bracci, Nikolov, and Thomas (Math. Z., 2021).

arxiv-2410-02829.title: LLMs May Not Be Human-Level Players, But They Can Be Testers: Measuring Game Difficulty with LLM Agents
arxiv-2410-02829.creator: Chang Xiao, Brenda Z. Yang
arxiv-2410-02829.description: Abstract . Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated their potential as autonomous agents across various tasks. One emerging application is the use of LLMs in playing games. In this work, we explore a practical problem for the gaming industry: Can LLMs be used to measure game difficulty?

arxiv-2501-11493.title: Communication-Efficient Federated Learning based on Explanation-Guided Pruning for Remote Sensing Image Classification
arxiv-2501-11493.creator: Jonas Klotz, Barış Büyüktaş, Begüm Demir
arxiv-2501-11493.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Jonas Klotz, Barış Büyüktaş, Begüm Demir. Federated learning (FL) is a decentralized machine learning paradigm in which multiple clients collaboratively train a global model by exchanging only model updates with the central server without sharing the local data of the clients. Due to the large volume of model updates required to be transmitted between clients and the central server, most FL systems are associated with high transfer costs (i.e., communication overhead).

arxiv-2510-19525.title: On the Robustness of AFDM and OTFS Against Passive Eavesdroppers Thanks: V. Savaux is with the Institute of Research and Technology b<>com, 35510 Cesson Sévigné, France (email: vincent.savaux@b-com.com). Thanks: H. S. Rou and G. T. F. de Abreu are with the School of Computer Science and Engineering,
arxiv-2510-19525.creator: Vincent Savaux, Hyeon Seok Rou, Zeping Sui
arxiv-2510-19525.description: Abstract We investigate the robustness of affine frequency division multiplexing (AFDM) and orthogonal time frequency space (OTFS) waveforms against passive eavesdroppers performing brute-force demodulation to intercepted signals, under the assumption that eavesdroppers have no knowledge of chirp parameters (in AFDM) or the delay–Doppler grid configuration (in OTFS), such that they must search exhaustively over possible demodulation matrices.

arxiv-2511-07516.title: Finding the boundary: Using galaxy membership to inform galaxy cluster extent through machine learning ⋆ Email: zhcekl@mit.edu ⋆ Email: zh102@wellesley.edu
arxiv-2511-07516.creator: Christine Hao 1 , 2 ⋆ {}^{1,2^{\star}} , Stephanie O’Neil 1,3,4 , Mark Vogelsberger 1 , Vinh Tran 1 , Lamiya Mowla 2 , and Joshua S. Speagle (沈佳士) 5,6,7,8
arxiv-2511-07516.description: Abstract The spatial extent of the environment’s impact on galaxies marks a transitional region between cluster and field galaxies. We present a data-driven method to identify this region in galaxy clusters with masses M 200 , mean > 10 13 ​ M ⊙ M_{200\rm,mean}>10^{13}{\rm M}_{\odot} at z = 0 z=0 .

pmc-10638472.title: The PtdIns3P phosphatase MtMP promotes symbiotic nitrogen fixation via mitophagy in Medicago truncatula
pmc-10638472.creator: Qixia Xue, Chen Shen, Qianwen Liu, Peng Liu, Da Guo, Lihua Zheng, Jinling Liu, Chang Liu, Qinyi Ye, Tao Wang, Jiangli Dong
pmc-10638472.description: SummarySymbiotic nitrogen fixation is a complex process in which legumes interact with rhizobia under nitrogen starvation. In this study, we found that myotubularin phosphatase (MtMP) is mainly expressed in roots and nodules in Medicago truncatula. MtMP promotes autophagy by dephosphorylating PtdIns3P on autophagosomes.

pmc-10714060.title: Akkermansia muciniphila promotes testosterone‐mediated hair growth inhibition in mice
pmc-10714060.creator: Eunyoung Lee, Daedong Kim, Hyo‐Deok Seo, Jeong‐Hoon Hahm, Jae‐Gu Seo, Sang‐Nam Lee, Do‐Hak Kim, Jiyun Ahn, Chang Hwa Jung
pmc-10714060.description: The beneficial effects of Akkermansia muciniphila (Akk) on gut health and inflammation reduction have been demonstrated; however, scientific evidence of hair growth enhancement by Akk has not been reported. Therefore, this study was undertaken to investigate the effect of Akk on improving testosterone‐mediated hair growth inhibition.

pmc-11365968.title: A differential network with multiple gated reverse attention for medical image segmentation
pmc-11365968.creator: Shun Yan, Benquan Yang, Aihua Chen
pmc-11365968.description: UNet architecture has achieved great success in medical image segmentation applications. However, these models still encounter several challenges. One is the loss of pixel-level information caused by multiple down-sampling steps. Additionally, the addition or concatenation method used in the decoder can generate redundant information.

pmc-11427035.title: Patient-reported Outcomes After Medial Meniscus Root Tear Repair Versus Other Medial Meniscus Repairs: An Exploratory Meta-analysis of Single-arm Cohorts
pmc-11427035.creator: Jared E. Gurba, Nomi S. Weiss-Laxer, Mohammad N. Haider, John M. Marzo
pmc-11427035.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Introduction:This study aimed to (1) compare patient-reported outcome measures between patients who underwent medial meniscus root tear (MMRT) repair and those who underwent other types of medial meniscus repair, and (2) identify factors associated with observed differences.Methods:A literature search identified studies reporting PROMs—knee injury and osteoarthritis outcome score (KOOS) or visual analog scale (VAS) for pain—after repair of the medial meniscus.

pmc-11531787.title: Generating Realistic and Representative Trajectories with Mobility Behavior Clustering
pmc-11531787.creator: Haowen Lin, Sina Shaham, Yao-Yi Chiang, Cyrus Shahabi
pmc-11531787.description: Accessing realistic human movements (aka trajectories) is essential for many application domains, such as urban planning, transportation, and public health. However, due to privacy and commercial concerns, real-world trajectories are not readily available, giving rise to an important research area of generating synthetic but realistic trajectories.

pmc-12554293.title: The dorsal column nuclei encode and transmit the network signatures of mechanical allodynia
pmc-12554293.creator: Amandine Virlogeux, Tejapratap Bollu, Xiangyu Ren, Ana M Palma, Martyn D Goulding
pmc-12554293.description: SUMMARYThe neural circuits that transmit the sense of pain and how pain is encoded by these circuits are still poorly understood.Mechanical allodynia is a prominent form of chronic pain characterized by painful responses to innocuous touch that develops as a consequence of nerve damage and inflammation.

pmc-12590675.title: Reproductive tract microbiota dysbiosis in ovarian endometrioma and adenomyosis: multi-site 16S rRNA profiling and functional impact of key bacterial species on human endometrial stromal cells
pmc-12590675.creator: Junchi Li, Yulin Zhang, Junli Zhang, Chong Yue, Lan Guo, Guangji Yang, Zhimei Jiang, Dongyan Ren, Tao Yu
pmc-12590675.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). ObjectiveTo characterize the reproductive tract microbiota in patients with ovarian chocolate cysts (CC) and adenomyosis (AM) compared to controls (NC), and investigate the in vitro effects of representative differential bacteria on human endometrial stromal cells (T-HESC).MethodsMicrobiota profiles from the cervical canal, posterior fornix, ascites, and endometrium of 20 CC, 20 AM, and 20 NC patients were analyzed using 16S rRNA sequencing.

pmc-12715115.title: An adult case of thrombocytopenia associated with posterior mediastinal hemangioma suggestive of Kasabach–Merritt phenomenon with uncertain diagnosis
pmc-12715115.creator: Yao Zhang, Kangle Zhu, Xiao Wang, Yi Zhao, Zhengcheng Liu, Jingwei Shi
pmc-12715115.description: Mediastinal hemangiomas are rare, accounting for <0.5% of all mediastinal tumors. Kasabach–Merritt phenomenon, characterized by thrombocytopenia and platelet consumption associated with vascular tumors such as Kaposiform hemangioendothelioma and tufted angioma, is even rarer, especially in adults. Adult cases of Kasabach–Merritt phenomenon complicated by posterior mediastinal hemangioma are exceedingly uncommon and pose significant diagnostic challenges.

pmc-13022980.title: Diabetic retinopathy severity detection using an improved Whale optimization algorithm and convolutional Kolmogorov-Arnold network
pmc-13022980.creator: Ashit Kumar Dutta, Nasser Ali Aljarallah, Abdul Rahaman Wahab Sait
pmc-13022980.description: IntroductionDiabetic retinopathy (DR) is an inflammatory condition affecting the retina caused by elevated and unregulated blood glucose levels. On a global scale, it is a contributing factor to vision impairment. Several deep learning (DL) methods use retinal images to identify DR severity. However, a significant improvement is required to assist medical professionals in recognizing DR in its early phases.

pmc-13384602.title: Association between lactate dehydrogenase-to-albumin ratio and oxygen therapy requirement in hospitalized patients with COVID-19: A retrospective observational study
pmc-13384602.creator: Hongsheng Deng, Kun Chen, Xinyong Liu, Jirun Chen
pmc-13384602.description: Although pulse oximetry (SpO2) is useful for real-time monitoring of oxygen saturation, it may not predict which patients will subsequently develop hypoxemia and require oxygen therapy. Laboratory biomarkers collected at admission may therefore facilitate earlier risk stratification and guide clinical decision-making.
